intro.title: Data controller
intro.p1: KopTup, located at Av. 68 #1-63, Bogotá, Colombia, is the controller of the personal data collected by this site (www.koptup.com) and its platform. For anything related to personal data, write to ronald@koptup.com or call +57 302 479 4842.
intro.p2: This policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for, who we share it with, how long we keep it and how you exercise your rights. When you submit a form you tick an authorization box: we store the date, the version of this policy and a hashed fingerprint of your IP address as proof of that authorization.

s1.title: 1. What data we collect and why

c1.subtitle: 1.1 Contact form
c1.text: Your name and email and, if you fill them in, your phone, company, the service you are interested in, budget, when you want to start and your message. We use them to answer you, prepare a quote and follow up commercially. The team gets a notice by email and, if enabled, by WhatsApp.

c2.subtitle: 1.2 Demo request
c2.text: Your name, company, job title, email, phone, country, company size, the demos you are interested in, your use case and the page you came from (including the campaign parameters in the address). We use them to review your request, create your demo access account if we approve it and send you the request emails: the acknowledgment, the approval with the activation link and the notice before your access expires.

c3.subtitle: 1.3 "Try it with your document"
c3.text: Your email and the document you upload. The document is processed only in the server's memory and is deleted automatically one hour later. To answer your questions, the parts of the document related to each question are sent to OpenAI. Your email is recorded as a sales contact.

c4.subtitle: 1.4 Account and client portal
c4.text: If you create an account, or we create it when we approve a demo: name, email, password (stored only as a hash, never in plain text), company, phone and last sign-in date. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email and profile picture. If you are a client, we store your projects, orders, deliverables, invoices and messages with the team.

c5.subtitle: 1.5 Chatbot
c5.text: In "Build your own" we store your bot's settings, the documents or pages you load into it and the questions asked through the widget on your site or the direct link, which are deleted automatically after 30 days. Questions in "Try the assistant" and in the preview are not stored. To write each answer, the question and the matching passages are sent to OpenAI.

c6.subtitle: 1.6 Browsing and security
c6.text: When you use the site, the server logs technical data (IP address, browser, requested page and time) to operate, limit abuse and fix errors. In the team's action log and in the proof of your authorizations, the IP is kept only as a hashed fingerprint. Cookies and browser storage are explained in the Cookie policy.

s2.title: 2. Who we share your data with

c1.subtitle: 2.1 Hosting and databases
c1.text: Vercel hosts the website; Railway, the platform server; MongoDB is the database where records are stored, and Redis keeps temporary information such as sessions and usage limits. If we enable it, Amazon Web Services (S3) stores the files you upload to the document manager. They act as processors: they handle data on our behalf to provide their service.

c2.subtitle: 2.2 Artificial intelligence
c2.text: OpenAI processes the text of the AI features (the chatbot, "Try it with your document" and the AI demos). It only receives what is needed to answer: the question, passages from the documents and the recent conversation history. We do not send it the data from the forms.

c3.subtitle: 2.3 Email and WhatsApp
c3.text: Resend sends the platform's emails: the notice to the team when you write to us through a form (with the data you sent), your demo request emails and your account emails, such as a password change. Meta, through the WhatsApp Business Platform, delivers to the team on WhatsApp the notice of a new contact, which carries your name, your company, the service you're interested in, your email and an excerpt of your message, and the notices of the orders and proposal requests you make from the client portal (your name, your email and the order amount and items, or your request's message). Both act as processors: they handle that data on our behalf only to make the delivery.

c4.subtitle: 2.4 Measurement and advertising, only if you accept them
c4.text: Google Analytics, Google Ads and LinkedIn receive data about your browsing only if you accept those cookies in the cookie notice or in the Cookie policy. You can withdraw that consent at any time.

c5.subtitle: 2.5 Sign in with Google
c5.text: If you choose to sign in with your Google account, Google confirms your identity and gives us your name, email and profile picture.

c6.subtitle: 2.6 Authorities and sale of data
c6.text: We only hand data over to an authority when a law or an order requires it. We do not sell, rent or transfer your personal data.

s3.title: 3. How long we keep your data

c1.subtitle: 3.1 Prospects and requests
c1.text: Rejected demo requests are anonymized automatically 24 months after they were rejected, and so is the data of people who have had no activity with us for 24 months (no account and no contract): name, email, phone and messages are deleted, and only statistical information remains.

c2.subtitle: 3.2 Accounts and clients
c2.text: Your account data is kept while you have the account. Data from a contractual relationship (accepted proposals, payments, projects, invoices) is kept while it lasts and afterwards for as long as accounting, tax and commercial rules require.

c3.subtitle: 3.3 Chatbot and documents
c3.text: "Try it with your document" files: 1 hour. Questions to a bot's widget: 30 days. Bots from "Build your own" are deleted after 12 months without use, together with their documents and history.

c4.subtitle: 3.4 Sessions and links
c4.text: A signed-in session lasts at most 7 days; after that you sign in again. Activation links expire after 72 hours and password reset links after one hour.

c1.subtitle: 4.1 Measures we apply
c1.text: Encrypted connection (HTTPS), passwords stored as hashes, admin panel access only for authorized team members according to their role, a log of the team's actions on requests and access, and submission limits against abuse.

c2.subtitle: 4.2 What we ask of you
c2.text: The demos are for testing: do not upload confidential information or other people's personal data to them. Use public or sample documents.

c1.subtitle: 5.1 Legal basis
c1.text: The authorization you give us by ticking the box on each form, or the need to perform the contract when you are a client. You can revoke the authorization at any time, except when the law or a current contract requires us to keep the data.

c2.subtitle: 5.2 Sensitive data
c2.text: We do not ask for sensitive data (such as health data, ethnic origin or biometric data) and you are not required to provide it. If a document you upload to a demo contains it, it is processed like the rest of the document and deleted within the stated period.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.subtitle: As the owner of your data, Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 gives you these rights:

r1.title: Know and correct
r1.description: Know, update and rectify your data, including when it is incomplete or misleading.

r2.title: Proof of authorization
r2.description: Request proof of the authorization you gave us (date and policy version).

r3.title: Know how we use it
r3.description: Be told what data we hold about you and what we use it for.

r4.title: Complain to the SIC
r4.description: File complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce after making your inquiry or claim with us.

r5.title: Revoke and erase
r5.description: Revoke your authorization and ask us to delete your data, unless the law or a current contract requires us to keep it.

r6.title: Free access
r6.description: Access your personal data free of charge.

rights.exerciseText: Write to us from the email you used to contact us (or tell us how to verify that you are the data subject), with your name, what you are asking for and, for a claim, the facts and supporting documents:
rights.responseTime: We answer inquiries within 10 business days (extendable by 5 more business days, with notice) and claims within 15 business days (extendable by 8 more business days, with notice). If a claim is incomplete, we will ask you for what is missing within the following 5 days; if 2 months go by without it, we will consider the claim withdrawn.

s6.title: 6. Cookies and browser storage
s6.p1: We use cookies and your browser's local storage to keep you signed in and remember your language, theme and cookie choice. Measurement (Google Analytics) and advertising (Google Ads and LinkedIn) cookies are only enabled if you accept them.
s6.p2: You can change your choice at any time from the Cookie policy or delete cookies from your browser.
s6.p3: To see each cookie and storage key with its purpose and duration, see the

s7.title: 7. International transfers
s7.p1: Several of our providers (Vercel, Railway, OpenAI, Google and LinkedIn, among others) may store or process data outside Colombia, mainly in the United States.
s7.p2: The authorization you give us includes these providers processing your data on our behalf and only for the purposes of this policy.

s8.title: 8. Minors
s8.p1: The site is aimed at businesses and is not intended for people under 18. If you wrote to us on behalf of a minor, let us know so we can erase their data.

s9.title: 9. Changes to this policy
s9.p1: If we change this policy, we publish the new version here with its date. Each authorization is stored with the version in force when you gave it, and if a change affects the purpose of the processing we will ask you for a new authorization.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.text: For questions about this policy or about your data, write to us:

c2.subtitle: 5.2 Exceptions

intro.title: What are cookies?
intro.p1: Cookies are small files a site stores in your browser. Besides cookies, this site uses your browser's local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) to remember some things without sending them to any server.
intro.p2: Here is the full list of what we use, checked against the site's code. Essential ones are needed for the site to work. Analytics and advertising ones are optional: they are only created if you accept them and if we have that measurement enabled.

devWebPage.servicesTitle: What can we develop for your business?
devWebPage.servicesSubtitle: Complete technology solutions, from design to deployment
devWebPage.sv1d: Enterprise systems, management portals, CRMs, ERPs and any web application your business needs. Modern stack with React and Node.js.
devWebPage.sv2d: RAG chatbots for WhatsApp and your website that answer with your company's documents, cite the source and are available at any hour. From {essentialFrom}, or a {pilotFrom} pilot (plus VAT if applicable).
devWebPage.sv3d: Online stores with shopping cart, inventory management and integration with the payment gateway you choose.
devWebPage.sv4d: Your business indicators connected to your data, with each figure and its source. We quote based on scope.
devWebPage.sv5d: Executive dashboards with KPIs, business metrics, charts and reports connected to your data.
devWebPage.sv6d: We automate repetitive processes using artificial intelligence: document processing, data analysis, report generation.
devWebPage.w1d: We develop with industry best practices. Maintainable, documented code ready to grow with your business.
devWebPage.w2d: Technical team in Bogotá. When the project needs it, we bring in specialists in design, AI or infrastructure.
devWebPage.w3d: Agile methodology with partial deliveries every week. Timelines and scope are written into the proposal.
devWebPage.w4d: We don't disappear after launch. We offer support, maintenance and continuous evolution of your product.
devWebPage.p1d: We understand your business, goals and users. We define the exact scope of the project.
devWebPage.p2d: We prototype the interface and technical architecture. You review and approve before a single line of code is written.
devWebPage.p3d: We develop with agile methodology. Partial deliveries each week so you can see progress.
devWebPage.p4d: We deploy to production, train your team and support you according to the agreed support plan.
devWebPage.techSubtitle: The first ones are what this site uses; the rest we define with you when quoting.
devWebPage.q1q: How much does it cost to hire a software development company in Colombia?
devWebPage.q1a: We publish our prices at www.koptup.com/services, in COP with a USD reference (plus VAT if applicable). RAG systems start with a {pilotFrom} pilot, and our other custom solutions are priced per plan according to scope. We offer a free, no-commitment quote to evaluate your specific case.
devWebPage.q2q: How long does it take to develop a web application?
devWebPage.q2a: It depends on the scope. An MVP (initial functional version) can be ready in 4-8 weeks. A complex system with multiple modules can take 3-6 months. In the initial analysis we define exact timelines.
devWebPage.q3q: Can KopTup develop chatbots for WhatsApp?
devWebPage.q3a: Yes. From the Professional plan, in your project we build the WhatsApp channel with the official WhatsApp Business API; the chatbot uses OpenAI models. They answer with your company's documents at any hour and, if they cannot find the answer, they say so. From {essentialFrom}, or a {pilotFrom} pilot (plus VAT if applicable).
devWebPage.q4q: Do you work with companies throughout Colombia or only in Bogotá?
devWebPage.q4a: We work remotely with companies in any city: meetings are by video call and we work in Spanish and English.
devWebPage.q5q: Do you offer maintenance after delivering the project?
devWebPage.q5a: Yes. We offer monthly maintenance and support plans. We also evolve the product according to your business needs. We don't leave you alone after launch.
devWebPage.q6q: Can I see examples of KopTup's work?
devWebPage.q6a: Yes. At www.koptup.com/demo there are {count} interactive demos: some use real AI, like the RAG chatbot, and most run on sample data; each demo says what is real. Open demos need no registration or credit card; the ones that require access can be requested at www.koptup.com/solicitar-demo.
